title: Free Financial Planning Guides | Vertical Wealth
description: Free guides for the money decisions that matter to your family. Download 12 questions to ask your financial advisor, with a new guide each month.

blocks.headline: Free guides for clearer decisions
blocks.body: Short, practical guides for the money decisions that matter most to your family. Download them free, with no form to fill out.

blocks.heading: Beyond the balance sheet: 12 questions to ask your financial advisor
blocks.body:
Choosing a financial advisor is a big decision, and so is deciding whether to stay with the one you have. This guide gives you 12 questions to ask, so you can look beyond the balance sheet and see whether an advisor is the right fit for your family.

It's a free PDF. Download it, print it and bring it to your next conversation with any advisor, including us.

blocks.heading: A new guide every month
blocks.body: We add a new free guide each month. Here's what's coming soon.

items.title: A year in giving
items.body: A simple way to plan your generosity across the whole year, so giving has a place in your plan in every season.

items.title: Old 401(k) roundup
items.body: Retirement accounts scattered across past jobs? A checklist for finding them, understanding your options and knowing what to ask before you move anything.

items.title: Business exit checklist
items.body: The decisions to work through before you sell or step away from a business, from timing to what the proceeds should do next.

blocks.heading: Hear when each guide is out
blocks.body: Get Weekly Lessons and we'll let you know when each new guide is ready. Each week you'll get one short email with scripture, a personal insight from Brian and one step to take. It's free, and you can unsubscribe any time.

blocks.heading: Rather talk it through?
blocks.body: Book a 15-minute, no-pressure discovery call with Brian. Bring your questions; there's no need to bring statements.
